title: Workshop 01 · Match the task
prompt: Group the supplied Lovable queries by user task. Propose one page per distinct task and identify what still needs live SERP evidence.
answer: Use separate tasks for understanding the tool, comparing alternatives, and configuring a domain. Similar wording alone does not justify more pages. Search demand and current result patterns remain unverified until observed.

title: Workshop 02 · Write a revision brief
prompt: Choose one paragraph from the supplied page. Specify the user task, evidence gap, proposed revision and verification step.
answer: Keep the original URL. Separate a proposed rewrite from a verified fact. Add primary sources or actual observations for claims; do not invent product capabilities, measurements or user stories.

title: Workshop 03 · Inspect the response
prompt: A page returns HTTP 200 but shows only Loading. State what is known, what to inspect next, and what remains unverified.
answer: Known: the request returned 200. Inspect the response body, rendered main content, resource failures and indexing directives. Actual Google indexing and successful user tasks remain unverified.

title: Workshop 04 · Verify delivery
prompt: Select one content block and one interaction. Record how to inspect initial HTML, rendered content, mobile usability and a relevant performance symptom.
answer: Use Network for the initial response and Elements for the rendered block. Perform the actual interaction. Record the device and conditions. A framework name or a single lab score does not establish indexing or real-user performance.

title: Workshop 05 · Connect claims to evidence
prompt: Choose three author or project claims. Classify each source, state the limit of the claim, and propose one concrete website revision.
answer: Separate self-description, first-hand project evidence and independent records. Add only verified roles and outcomes. Link claims to relevant material; do not invent credentials, testimonials or expert review.

title: Workshop 06 · Review AI suggestions
prompt: For each supplied suggestion, choose accept, revise or reject. Cite the original input and state the verification step.
answer: Accept a structural proposal only when it serves the page task. Revise claims needing current primary sources. Reject invented rankings, unsupported capabilities and fabricated authorship. Preserve the original and the decision record.

title: Workshop 07 · Design an observation
prompt: Design one informational query, one comparison query and one brand-fact query. Define the fields needed to verify each linked statement.
answer: Record the exact prompt, platform, mode, date, region/language, answer and source URL. Check whether the source supports the statement. Leave results empty until a real observation is saved; do not invent citations.

title: Workshop 08 · Choose the next actions
prompt: Select three actions for one real page. For each, record evidence, user benefit, owner, completion criteria, review date and remaining uncertainty.
answer: Prioritise a blocking delivery problem before cosmetic changes. Require primary evidence for claims. Define a checkable result and preserve the baseline. Do not promise ranking, AI citation or business growth without actual evidence.
